name: 关联详情面板
description: 展示与当前选中数据联动的详情内容和详情操作
use_when: 主表、主列表或主对象需要在同页联动展示详情

interaction.open: 点击一行详情，展示该行详情面板
interaction.switch: 点击另一行详情，更新面板内容并保持展开
interaction.close: 再次点击当前行详情，隐藏面板

table_composition.placement: inside table collection module, at the right of table list
table_composition.separator_ownership: filter bottom owns the only horizontal separator; detail pane owns only its left vertical separator
